desc.zh: 每行在第一个更小元素处断开；按列读三角表，活着的起点就是一个单调栈。
desc.en: Each row stops at the first smaller element; read the triangle by columns and the alive starts form a monotonic stack.

complexity: O(n) time: each element is pushed once and popped at most once; O(n) auxiliary space for the stack

concepts.name: Valid run ends at the first smaller element
concepts.description: Start i is valid exactly for ends before the first element smaller than nums[i].

concepts.name: Alive starts as a monotonic stack
concepts.description: Pop strictly larger tops, push the new start, and add the stack size; ties stay alive.
